requirements.sourceQuote: A Master's degree (including a written thesis) or a comparable academic qualification in the broad field of Earth System Sciences: physics, geophysical sciences (including meteorology and oceanography), chemistry, ecology, mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics, or political science
Since the programme focuses strongly on numerical simulations, candidates with computer literacy (e.g. Unix environment, Python programming or other programming languages) will be given priority.
No minimum language level required (proficiency assessment via test or interview)
